description: This is a PHP source class file defining the Opencart Admin Controller for handling SEO URLs. It includes methods for listing, filtering, editing, and deleting SEO URLs within the admin panel, including building URLs with various filters, sorting options, and pagination.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO URL entries in the admin panel, extending the core Controller class.

methods.description: Main entry point for displaying and handling SEO URL filtering and editing interface.
